system.description:
When you step in to defend someone, roll with the questions:

  • Are you trying to impress them?
  • Is the law being broken?

success.value:
Hold 3. While you stand in their defense, you may spend hold one-for-one to:

  • Protect them from an attack; take the hit instead of them.
  • Keep someone from leaving a room unless they go through you.

  • Take +1 on your next roll to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out} against someone who threatens harm.

partial.value:

failure.label: Miss
failure.value: You are too predictable and find yourself at the aggressor's mercy. They can make you mark a condition or make the person you were protecting mark a condition.
